status: Native active-layer reveal and minimal scrolling tested and packaged; live Photoshop qualification pending
implementation: Panel-owned selection tracker opens only closed ancestors after actual active-layer change.
First document appearance/read/switch and unchanged selection preserve disclosure and manual scroll.
Guarded one-shot deferred scrollTo with nil anchor and disabled animation exposes target minimally.
Read/revert and close rotate ephemeral store generation to invalidate stale requests; copied document UUIDs remain isolated by runtime store identity.
Explicit inline-name requests remain minimal and bind their draft identity.
Panel disappearance cancels pending requests while retaining the last observed selection; reappearance reveals hidden-time selection changes and explicit pending Rename targets.
limits: Native-hosted tests are not physical input or exact Photoshop UI qualification.
Filters may exclude active rows; no forced filter changes or delayed reveal when filters later change.
Selection changes while editing is blocked are observed but do not queue later automatic reveals.
Universal macOS14+ compilation is not Intel/macOS14 runtime certification.
Full Photoshop feature and byte parity remain incomplete.
